issues.on_page: Line 45 Solid Waste 31,114.33, under 'Business-Type Activities', General Fund column
issues.issue: The statement prints this under the business-type heading, but it is paid from the General Fund. Keeping it governmental is defensible but questionable.
Splitting by fund column is fine, but calling these Utility Charges is an assumption: no breakdown is printed (applies to receipts[11] and receipts[12]).
